NSCameraUsageDescription: Flowi uses the camera to scan QR labels on boxes and to take photos of boxes and items.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Flowi records meeting audio only when you tap “Record”, to save it to that meeting.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Flowi opens your photos so you can attach pictures of boxes and items, and screenshots to feedback reports.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Flowi uses Face ID to protect your saved sign-in details.
NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Flowi reads steps, heart rate and resting heart rate, sleep and its stages, weight, SpO₂ and distance from Health to show them in the Health section.
NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Flowi does not write data to Health; it only reads it.
